top_signals.title: Asian Shares Rise as Oil Drop Eases Inflation Woes: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian shares rose, led by chipmakers, as a decline in crude oil eased concerns about quickening inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Japan strategizes to support forestry industry revitalization
top_signals.summary: The plans are expected to include consolidation of forests held by different owners, use of information and communication technology, and improving lumber products' added value.
